Objects with intention.   Spaces with soul.

Context

An original fictional lifestyle store brief, created to demonstrate visual design and website structure. No client commissioned this work.

My role

Concept direction, visual identity exploration, interface design, and responsive implementation.

Design decisions

Earthy colours and sculptural product forms give the collection a quiet, tactile feel. A short headline and clear navigation keep the offer readable.

Finished exploration & limitations

This visual concept is included in the studio website. It is not a deployed shop or client website. There are no live transactions, user studies, analytics, or verified business results.
